risks.proof: A video of the engine running with a clear audio and visual check of all components.

risks.risk: The engine may have seized or seized pistons.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being turned over with a crank or a video of a compression test.

risks.risk: The engine may have a blown head gasket.

Photo of the engine bay to see the condition of the radiator and hoses.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
